bounded_objective: Audit whether the A002 arbitrary-seed joint embedding is noncircular for each A003 endpoint, prove an admission limit when it exists, and locate a proved class hypothesis or exact transformed statistic when it fails.
method: Independent reconstruction of activation and surgery; a new continuity bound for L under one truth-table flip; exact Fourier decomposition of L under sparse activation; exact entropy decrement for an activation control; endpoint-by-endpoint scope classification.
prior_status: A002 preserved global H/I in the simultaneous full-support, low-total-influence, diffuse-influence, rare-output class, but preservation of DOWN, STEP, and the posterior-forest residual was unresolved.
mathematical_delta: Proved that the A002 embedding also preserves L/I and therefore the restricted optimal downward constant equals C_L for every eta>0. Proved that each activation control has STEP ratio tending to 4, so this architecture provably fails to preserve arbitrary seed STEP statistics. The posterior-forest converse remains open because its structural witnesses are existentially optimized.

deliverable_status.packet_target: AT_LEAST_ONE_LIVE_ENDPOINT_RESOLVED; broader endpoint review and full FEI remain open

next_action: A086 or A094 should reconstruct the one-point L continuity bound, the activated-L decomposition, and the control decrement limit. After acceptance, use the exact asymptotic price 4—not an unquantified cheap-control phrase—when screening future STEP embeddings.
blockers: Both new A005 claims require an independent reviewer outside the contributing B01 stream.
No alternative embedding preserving high STEP criticality is known.
